text_block_list.text: Hmm... That wasn't the best, was it?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски sighs at the sight of her
time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Maybe I've been a little overzealous
lately?
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
If I want to get faster, I might need to do
a little
personal maintenance...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should take a drive on the
highway to
refresh myself. It's been a
while.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски seems to be getting
tired—perhaps
from running too many
consecutive races. I should
review her
race schedule...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
